name: Rajasthan Public Works Department
summary: The state department that builds and maintains Rajasthan's state highways, major district roads and bridges.
about: Rajasthan is the largest state in India by area and much of it is desert, so its Public Works Department maintains very long roads serving very few people. Sand drift, extreme summer heat and flash flooding in the monsoon are the recurring problems its road engineers deal with.
facts: Responsible for Rajasthan's state highways and major district roads.
Also looks after most state-owned bridges and government buildings.
National highways in the state are not its responsibility — those belong to NHAI, NHIDCL or the state's national highway wing.
